title: My disputes
intro: When something recorded or done was wrong (a charge, the medicines you got, a missed-visit strike), the facility checks the records and decides within 10 days.
emptyBody: To raise one, open the visit, medicine or document and choose Report a problem.
fromItem: Open the visit, medicine or document the problem is about, then choose Report a problem.
whatWrongHint: Say what happened and what you expected. The facility sees the records too.
tooShort: Say what went wrong in a sentence or two.
clinicalNote: MediLink does not judge medical treatment. For a medical concern, speak to the facility's management or the professional council.
statementHint: The record was not changed. Your statement is kept with it, and anyone reading the record sees it.

next.info_requested: The facility asked you something. Reply below.
next.resolved: Accept the decision, or disagree within 14 days and MediLink decides.
next.closed: You can reopen it once within 30 days if you have new facts.

outcome.correction_refused: The record stays as it is
outcome.rebooking: A new time will be offered
